metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was the temperature over John F. Kennedy International Airport higher than on any other day in June 2020 to 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), New York (approximately 40.6413°N, -73.7781°W) - Date: June 24, 2025 (comparison date) vs June 2020-2024 (historical period) - Collection: ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY for temperature data 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5 temperature data (it's reanalysis data, not optical) - Will need to extract temperature values and compare 3. Logic: - Get temperature on June 24, 2025 - Get max temperature for each day in June 2020-2024 - Find the historical maximum - Compare: If June 24, 2025 temp > historical max → A, else → B - Valid Zero: Temperature can be legitimately low (e.g., 0°C or negative in winter), but June temps should be positive - C1: If no data exists for the dates - C2: Should not occur with ERA5 (global coverage) - C3: If temperature values are None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., <-100°C or >100°C) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define JFK Airport location const jfk = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.7781, 40.6413]); // 2. Get temperature on June 24, 2025 const date2025 = '2025-06-24'; const col2025 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(date2025, '2025-06-25') .filterBounds(jfk) .select('temperature_2m'); const size2025 = col2025.size().getInfo(); console.log(`June 24, 2025 images: ${size2025}`); if (size2025 === 0) { console.log("No data for June 24, 2025"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get mean temperature for June 24, 2025 (convert from Kelvin to Celsius) const temp2025K = col2025.mean().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: jfk, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); if (temp2025K === null || temp2025K === undefined) { console.log("Failed to get 2025 temperature"); console.log("C3"); return; } const temp2025 = temp2025K - 273.15; console.log(`June 24, 2025 temp: ${temp2025.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Validate temperature range if (temp2025 < -50 || temp2025 > 60) { console.log("Invalid temperature range for 2025"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 3. Get historical June temperatures (2020-2024) const historicalYears = [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]; let maxHistoricalTemp = -999; for (let year of historicalYears) { const startDate = `${year}-06-01`; const endDate = `${year}-07-01`; const colYear = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(jfk) .select('temperature_2m'); const sizeYear = colYear.size().getInfo(); if (sizeYear === 0) { console.log(`No data for June ${year}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get max temperature for this June const maxTempK = colYear.max().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: jfk, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); if (maxTempK === null || maxTempK === undefined) { console.log(`Failed to get ${year} temperature`); console.log("C3"); return; } const maxTemp = maxTempK - 273.15; console.log(`June ${year} max: ${maxTemp.toFixed(2)}°C (${sizeYear} imgs)`); if (maxTemp > maxHistoricalTemp) { maxHistoricalTemp = maxTemp; } } console.log(`Historical max (2020-2024): ${maxHistoricalTemp.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 4. Compare and determine answer if (temp2025 > maxHistoricalTemp) { console.log("June 24, 2025 was hotter than any day in June 2020-2024"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("June 24, 2025 was NOT hotter than historical maximum"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
